IGUI_MBLD_Note_post: Closes the gap where walls or fences meet, or ends a fence. It sits in the square's corner and doesn't take a wall line.
IGUI_MBLD_Note_wallHang: If that side of the square has a wall, it sticks to the wall like the map's own and disappears when the wall is dismantled or destroyed. Without a wall it is placed on its own.
IGUI_MBLD_Note_well: The water here never runs out, even after the water supply shuts off.
IGUI_MBLD_Note_water: Blocks people and zombies. You can take water from it (tainted, purify before drinking) and fish here. Dismantling fills it back to the original ground. Can only be dug on natural ground such as grass or dirt.
IGUI_MBLD_Note_plant: Decoration only: it does not grow and gives no harvest.
IGUI_MBLD_Note_plantGrass: Decoration only; it does not grow. Anyone can clear it with the right-click "Remove Grass" action; that gives the usual 2 to 3 Grass Cuttings, not a refund of what you paid.
IGUI_MBLD_Why_Title: "%1" is a game tile, but Build Anything doesn't list it
IGUI_MBLD_Why_LUA: The game or another mod rewrites this tile or gives it a function by its name, so after you place it, it would turn into something else or stop working.
IGUI_MBLD_Why_WINDOW_STATE: This is a window shown open, broken or without glass. Search for the closed window instead.
IGUI_MBLD_Why_PREFIX: Crops, trees, bushes, snow overlays and the glow overlays of lights are not listed. Grow crops with vanilla farming.
IGUI_MBLD_Why_ENTITY: It belongs to the build recipe %1, which is not in your recipe list right now: not learned yet, not your skill tier (for example, wooden walls change with Carpentry level), or an admin turned off its kind.
IGUI_MBLD_Why_ENTITY_HIDDEN: It belongs to the build recipe %1. %2 hides this recipe from the build menu, so neither the vanilla build window nor Build Anything lists it. If %2 has its own build menu, build it from there.
IGUI_MBLD_Why_ENTITY_NONE: Objects with special functions and no build recipe are not listed (coffee machines, for example).
IGUI_MBLD_Why_PLANT: Trees, bushes and things with a special function (fuel pumps, generators, appliances) are not listed.
IGUI_MBLD_Why_DOOR_OPEN: This is a door shown open. Search for the closed door instead.
IGUI_MBLD_Why_INVINCIBLE: Unbreakable windows and pieces that make a window unbreakable are not listed.
IGUI_MBLD_Why_WATER: It holds endless water, so it is not listed.
IGUI_MBLD_Why_COLLECTOR: Rain collector barrels and other water drums built here would not hold water, so they are not listed. For rain collectors, pick the items marked Recipe: they use the vanilla recipe.
IGUI_MBLD_Why_STACK: This is how it looks when stacked; loading the map turns it into another tile. Search for the unstacked one instead.
IGUI_MBLD_Why_STAIRS_PART: Stair pieces that can be picked up or scrapped are not listed.
IGUI_MBLD_Why_STAIRS_SET: Stairs are listed by their bottom piece, and only when all three pieces exist.
IGUI_MBLD_Why_PART: This is one square of a multi-square object. Search for the square it starts from.
IGUI_MBLD_Why_BAD_GRID: The game's tile data places the pieces of this object in the wrong spots, so it would be built split apart. It is not listed.
IGUI_MBLD_Why_LIGHT: This light's color settings are incomplete, so it wouldn't light up or would cause errors.
IGUI_MBLD_Why_CURTAIN_CLOSED: This is a curtain shown closed. Search for the open one instead.
IGUI_MBLD_Why_BLOCKS_EDGE: It blocks one side of a square without being a wall, so zombies wouldn't come to break it. It is not listed.
IGUI_MBLD_Why_NO_KIND: It has no property that tells what kind of thing it is (wall, floor, furniture...).
